content:
Alongside the ongoing deal on AirPods 4, we have ongoing deals on Apple Watch Ultra 3 at nearly $100 off, rare Prime Day lows still live on Apple Magic Mouse and Keyboards, Anker’s white model 3-in-1 25W foldable MagSafe charger back at the Prime Day low, and even more waiting below.

While not all of the best Apple accessories are still live from Prime Day, some of them are, and we are talking about some of the more rare deals on Apple gear. More specifically its base Magic Keyboard, this model with the Touch ID, and the black Magic Mouse. Alongside an ongoing deal on AirPods 4, these three Magic accessories are almost never down at prices this low and we wanted to make sure they are front and center for folks looking to upgrade there Apple input devices before the prices jump back up.

When it comes to Apple Magic accessories, the current-generation iterations with the USB-C charging port, anything in the 20% off range is particularly notable. Deals can be far and few between on this gear, so any sort of savings we can land is welcome. The prices we are featuring here today are the same deals that were live for Amazon’s giant Prime Day bonanza in late June, but after seeing some of them jump back up and down again, we wanted to shine some light here before they potentially jump back up for good (another year, or who knows how long)

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $145 (Reg. $179)

We are getting another chance at some savings on the latest Apple Watch Ultra 3 this week. There were some notable deals during Prime Day a couple weeks ago, but if you missed out then, there are a number of configurations at nearly $100 off via Amazon right now.

Alongside some of the more pricey Milanese models, you will also find deals across various standard configurations including the one size fits just about everyone Ocean Band models in both Black and Natural Titanium:

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Anchor Blue Ocean Band $699 (Reg. $799)

While most of the other $99 price drops live this week are landing on large size band options, these Ocean Band models will fit just about any wrist while delivering options for both the Black and Natural case colors at the discounted rate.

Again, most of these models were lower during Prime Day, but that was the only time we have seen them down any lower than we have here today, and discounts have been generally hard to come by on Ultra 3 since release.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Black Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Blue Trail Loop $699 (Reg. $799)
  • Natural Apple Watch Ultra 3 w/ Natural Milanese Loop $799 (Reg. $899)

Amazon offering Apple’s AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off

Amazon now offering MacBook Neo at $110 off the new list price (Likely not for long)

The upgraded MacBook Neo 512GB model with the Touch Magic Keyboard just saw a $100 price hike to $799, but Amazon just dropped the price back down to $689 shipped.

Amazon is now offering the Indigo blue 512GB MacBook Neo down at $689.99 shipped. Now regularly $799, this is nearly $110 off the new list price.

Despite only landing $10 under the pre-price hike listing, this is actually now $109 off and matching the lowest price Amazon has ever offered it for anyway.

The new 2026 MacBook Neo 512GB never dropped below the $689 we have here today even before Apple jacked the price up by $100 – you’re effectively looking at the lowest price ever and the best deal we have tracked since the price hike took hold at Amazon.

We can only assume this deal will not last for long as it is only available on the Indigo colorway and none of the b are 256GB variants are seeing the same price relief right now – get in there while you can if you’re interested.

Updating…

Apple’s 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 2TB models are $449 off this week, more

We just spotted another chance to land an M5 Pro MacBook Pro at a sizable $449 off the new list price. While the Space Black model was already available, you can now add this 2TB silver M5 Pro MacBook Pro to the list of heavily discounted machines as it is now also at nearly $450 off.

Amazon is now offering the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and the 2TB internal SSD down at $2,549.99 shipped.

This is the model with the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU that now fetches $2,999 straight from Apple. Today’s deals have both the Space Black and Silver model sitting at $449 less than that at Amazon to deliver one of the best deals we have tracked on the current-generation MacBook lineup since the new prices took hold there.

This is the most affordable 2TB M5 Pro machine you can buy, and while that might be overkill for some folks, with such a deep discount from the new, much higher price tag, we wanted to make sure it was on your radar – you’ll also find this same machine with the 18-core CPU/20-core GPU at $449 off as well.

Here’s a look at how deal pricing is working out across the lineup at Amazon right now as there are several configurations sitting at well below the new list prices:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,899 (Reg. $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,374 (Reg. $2,499)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 15-Core $2,549 (Reg. $2,999)
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 18-Core $2,749 (Reg. $3,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,649 (Reg. $2,999)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 36GB/2TB $3,849 (Reg. $4,399)

You can land a mid-range M5 iPad Pro at $250 off before the prices go up at Amazon

Alongside the up to $449 off we are tracking on the M5 Pro MacBook lineup, Amazon is also delivering some notable price hike relief on the M5 iPad Pro lineup right now with more than a few configurations sitting at $250 under the new list prices.

Apple’s M5 iPad Pro was already pricey and it just went up again, but there are some notable discounts sitting over at Amazon right now on various mid-range models across both the 11-inch and 13-inch form-factors:

M5 iPad Pro 11-inch:

  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 512GB $1,149 (Now Reg. $1,399)
  • 11-inch M5 iPad Pro 1TB $1,549 (Now Reg. $1,799)
